children.description: Bartonella henselae, formerly Rochalimæa henselae, is a bacterium that is the causative agent of cat-scratch disease (bartonellosis).

children.name: Bartonella volans

children.name: Bartonella bacilliformis
children.description: Bartonella bacilliformis is a bacterium, Gram negative aerobic, pleomorphic, flagellated, motile, coccobacillary, 2–3 μm long, 0.2–0.5 μm wide, and a facultative intracellular bacterium.

children.name: Bartonella melophagi
children.description: "Candidatus Bartonella melophagi" is a candidatus species of Bartonella that causes infection in humans.
